name: Dimapur–Senapati National Highway
significance: NH 129A is a branch of NH 129. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Dimapur to Senapati, and it meets NH 129 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 129 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Dimapur to BOGORIJENG — NARAKANWAR REGION
